answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 60772 Country: Pakistan Title: Removal of hairs Question: I have plenty of hairs at my back right down the neck and they are also same in front of chest, is it allowed to remove? If yes then can I use wax? Please describe. Answer ID: 60772 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1086/862/D=10/1436) According to scholars of fiqh, removing of chest hair etc is against etiquette i.e. it should not be removed unnecessarily. However, if one feels pain or difficulty then one may remove it. It also may be removed by waxing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
